claim: The default limit on domains is 20 for new customers as of March 2021.
question: What is the default domain limit for a new AWS account?

evidence.quote: The limit is 20 for new customers as of March 2021.

claim: An existing account whose default domain limit is 50 keeps a limit of 50.
question: What happens to an existing account whose domain limit is 50?

qualifiers.condition: Existing account with a default limit of 50

evidence.quote: If you have an existing account and your default limit is 50 now, it will remain at 50.

claim: With three accounts that each have 500 private hosted zones, you can link one VPC with all 1,500 private hosted zones.
question: Can one VPC be associated with private hosted zones that belong to several accounts?

qualifiers.condition: Example: three accounts, each at the default quota of 500 hosted zones

evidence.quote: If you create 500 private hosted zones for all three accounts, you can link a VPC with all 1,500 private hosted zones.

claim: Each IP address in a VPC Resolver endpoint can process up to 10,000 UDP DNS queries per second (QPS).
question: How many DNS queries per second can one IP address in a Resolver endpoint process?

qualifiers.scope: per IP address in an endpoint
qualifiers.condition: The actual QPS varies by query type, response size, target name server health, response times, round trip latency and protocol

evidence.quote: Each IP address in an endpoint can process up to 10,000 UDP DNS queries per second (QPS).

claim: If connection tracking is enforced by restrictive security group rules, or queries are routed through Network Load Balancer, the maximum queries per second per IP address for an inbound endpoint can be as low as 1500.
question: How low can the queries per second per IP address of an inbound Resolver endpoint fall?

qualifiers.scope: per IP address of an inbound endpoint
qualifiers.condition: Connection tracking enforced by restrictive security group rules, or queries routed through Network Load Balancer

evidence.quote: If connection tracking is enforced by restrictive security group rules or queries are routed through Network Load Balancer, the maximum queries per second per IP address for an inbound endpoint can be as low as 1500.

claim: If your maximum query rate exceeds 50% of the capacity for any network interface in the endpoint, you can add more network interfaces to increase the endpoint capacity.
question: When should you add network interfaces to a Resolver endpoint?

qualifiers.scope: per network interface in an endpoint

evidence.quote: If your maximum query rate exceeds 50% of the capacity for any network interface in the endpoint, you can add more network interfaces to increase the endpoint capacity.

claim: A ChangeResourceRecordSets request cannot contain more than 1,000 ResourceRecord elements, including alias records.
question: How many ResourceRecord elements can one ChangeResourceRecordSets request contain?

qualifiers.condition: Each ResourceRecord element is counted twice when the Action is UPSERT

evidence.quote: A request cannot contain more than 1,000 `ResourceRecord` elements (including alias records).

claim: When the Action of a ChangeResourceRecordSets request is UPSERT, each ResourceRecord element counts twice toward the limit.
question: How does UPSERT count toward the ChangeResourceRecordSets element limit?

evidence.quote: When the value of the `Action` element is `UPSERT`, each `ResourceRecord` element is counted twice.

claim: The sum of the characters, including spaces, in all Value elements of a ChangeResourceRecordSets request cannot exceed 32,000 characters.
question: How many characters can all Value elements of one ChangeResourceRecordSets request hold?

qualifiers.condition: Each character counts twice when the Action is UPSERT

evidence.quote: The sum of the number of characters (including spaces) in all `Value` elements in a request cannot exceed 32,000 characters.

claim: VPC Resolver API requests are limited to five per second per AWS account per Region, and more requests return an HTTP 400 Throttling error.
question: How many VPC Resolver API requests per second does an account get per Region?

qualifiers.condition: Above five requests per second VPC Resolver returns HTTP 400 with Code Throttling

evidence.quote: Five requests per second per AWS account per Region.

claim: To view Route 53 quotas or request higher ones in Service Quotas, you must change the Region to US East (N. Virginia).
question: In which Region do you view and raise Route 53 quotas?

qualifiers.condition: VPC Resolver quotas are viewed in the applicable Region instead

evidence.quote: To view quotas and request higher quotas for Route 53, you must change the Region to US East (N. Virginia).

claim: For each public hosted zone that you create, Route 53 automatically creates a name server (NS) record and a start of authority (SOA) record.
question: Which records does Route 53 create automatically for a public hosted zone?

values.display: automatically creates a name server (NS) record

evidence.quote: For each public hosted zone that you create, Amazon Route 53 automatically creates a name server (NS) record and a start of authority (SOA) record.

claim: By default, Route 53 assigns a unique set of four name servers, called a delegation set, to each hosted zone that you create.
question: How many name servers does Route 53 assign to a hosted zone?

qualifiers.condition: Unique set per zone by default; a reusable delegation set lets zones share the same four

evidence.quote: By default, Route 53 assigns a unique set of four name servers (called a delegation set) to each hosted zone that you create.

claim: When you create several hosted zones with the same name, Route 53 assigns four name servers to each zone and the name servers differ for each one.
question: Do hosted zones that have the same name share name servers?

values.display: four name servers to every hosted zone

evidence.quote: Route 53 assigns four name servers to every hosted zone, and the name servers differ for each one.

question: Can you create a reusable delegation set in the console?
